description: Permanently delete a note from the vault. Deletes on the first call without asking the user to confirm. Recovery requires the local trash in Obsidian — there is no API-level undo.

oneOf.description: Address a note by its vault-relative path.
Address whichever file is currently active in the Obsidian UI.

type.description: Address the file currently open in Obsidian.

oneOf.description: Address a periodic note (current or dated).

date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the current period.

name: obsidian_delete_note

currentSizeInBytes.description: Always 0 after a successful delete — the file no longer exists.

deleted.description: True when the file was removed.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `path_forbidden`: The target path is outside OBSIDIAN_WRITE_PATHS, or OBSIDIAN_READ_ONLY=true denies all writes. `note_missing`: No note has exactly this vault path, letter case included. Near matches in the same folder, such as a different-case spelling, are listed in `suggestions` and never deleted in its place. `no_active_file`: Target was `active` but no file is currently open in Obsidian. `periodic_unsupported`: Target was `periodic` and this vault runs Local REST API v5.0.2 or later without the companion periodic-notes extension, so the `/periodic/` routes are not served at all. `periodic_not_found`: Target was `periodic`, the `/periodic/` routes are served on this vault, and no note exists for the requested period. `periodic_disabled`: Target was `periodic` but the requested period is not enabled in Obsidian's Periodic Notes plugin settings. `path_is_directory`: The supplied path names a folder rather than a note file. Deleting a folder is not offered — the upstream removes it and everything inside it in one unrecoverable step. `path_traversal`: The path contains a `.` or `..` segment, which is rejected to prevent vault escape. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

path.description: Resolved vault-relative path of the deleted note.

previousSizeInBytes.description: Byte size of the note immediately before deletion. Confirms the size of what was removed.

title: Obsidian Delete Note
